subject: planner: add decorrelate-apply test & add support for move out intermediary GE from memo. (#59171)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent (planner/cascades + logicalop). Main behavior change: rules’ `XForm` can now request removing an intermediary source `GroupExpression`, implemented via `Memo.RemoveOut()` and invoked from `ApplyRuleTask` after inserting replacement expressions. Decorrelate-apply rule is refactored, now respects `LogicalApply.NoDecorrelate` in `PreCheck`, and a new test validates intermediary-apply deletion behavior. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in memo lifecycle safety, rule application flow, or SQL semantics for the touched paths.
